This is overfitting to the specific test cases rather than fixing the underlying bug, and introduces potential ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException risks.

This overfits to the specific test cases where charno happens to equal sourceExcerpt.length() (end-of-line errors) but breaks the general safety mechanism and introduces potential IndexOutOfBoundsException risks.
